mapper.select: SELECT ic.code, ic.name, ic.unit, io.value, io.observation_date FROM indicator_catalog ic JOIN indicator_observation io ON ic.id = io.indicator_id WHERE ic.code IN ('FORWARD_EPS', 'EPS_REV_3M', 'EPS_SURPRISE', 'EPS_GROWTH_YOY') AND io.observation_date = ( SELECT MAX(io2.observation_date) FROM indicator_observation io2 WHERE io2.indicator_id = ic.id ) ORDER BY ic.id
SELECT ec.asof_date, ec.horizon, ec.estimated_eps, ec.provider FROM earnings_consensus ec WHERE ec.index_code = 'NDX' AND ec.horizon = #{horizon} ORDER BY ec.asof_date

SELECT curr.asof_date, curr.estimated_eps AS current_eps, prev_1m.estimated_eps AS eps_1m_ago, prev_3m.estimated_eps AS eps_3m_ago FROM earnings_consensus curr LEFT JOIN earnings_consensus prev_1m ON prev_1m.index_code = curr.index_code AND prev_1m.horizon = curr.horizon AND prev_1m.asof_date = date(curr.asof_date, '-1 month') LEFT JOIN earnings_consensus prev_3m ON prev_3m.index_code = curr.index_code AND prev_3m.horizon = curr.horizon AND prev_3m.asof_date = date(curr.asof_date, '-3 months') WHERE curr.index_code = 'NDX' AND curr.horizon = #{horizon} ORDER BY curr.asof_date
